His actions had a profound effect, and he remains revered in Bangladesh for his efforts in raising awareness about the crisis. The Nixon administration's policy, driven by concerns about Soviet influence, was to support Pakistan, but Kennedy's report to the Senate Judiciary Committee on Refugees shed light on the systematic campaign of terror and genocidal consequences perpetrated by the Pakistani army.

article_content: In Ivory Coast, President Alassane Ouattara has initiated negotiations with opposition parties to address concerns surrounding the upcoming parliamentary elections. The goal is to convince supporters of former President Laurent Gbagbo to participate in the elections, rather than boycotting them. This development comes after Gbagbo's party withdrew from the electoral commission, citing unfair modifications to the commission's composition. The party also denounced the prevailing 'climate of terror' that prevents leaders from freely participating in the elections. The parliamentary elections are scheduled for mid-December and will conclude the electoral process that began with the disputed presidential elections last November. Ouattara was declared the winner, but the results were annulled by the Constitutional Council, leading to a crisis that claimed over 3,000 lives. The World Bank has emphasized the need for credible elections to secure international support for development projects. Meanwhile, Ouattara has established the Commission on Dialogue, Truth and Reconciliation to promote healing and unity in the aftermath of the post-electoral crisis.

article_content: Mae Hannah Mills wedi ennill medal aur yn yr hwylio yn y Gemau Olympaidd, gan olygu bod Cymru bellach wedi ennill tair medal aur yn Rio. Dim ond angen gorffen oedd Mills a'i phartner Saskia Clark yn ras olaf y dosbarth 470, wedi iddyn nhw sicrhau'r aur i bob pwrpas ddydd Mawrth. Cafodd y ras ei gohirio ddydd Mercher o achos yr amodau tywydd, ond fe groesodd y ddwy y llinell derfyn ddydd Iau gan sicrhau'r fuddugoliaeth. Mae Mills, 28 oed o Gaerdydd, a Clark, sy'n 36 o Essex, wedi mynd gam ymhellach na'u medal arian yng Ngemau Llundain yn 2012. 'Does gen i ddim geiriau i ddisgrifio'r peth,' meddai Mills. 'Alla i ddim credu'r peth.' Rydyn ni wedi hwylio'n anhygoel. Mae hi wedi bod yn farathon o ddigwyddiad. Jo Aleh a Polly Powrie o Seland Newydd gafodd y fedal arian, a Helene Defrance a Camille Lecointre o Ffrainc ddaeth yn drydydd gan sicrhau'r fedal efydd. Rio nawr yw'r Gemau Olympaidd mwyaf llwyddiannus erioed i Gymru. Hyd yn hyn, maen nhw wedi ennill tair medal aur a chwe medal arian. Ond mae gobaith y bydd mwy ar y ffordd hefyd, gyda Jade Jones yn cystadlu yn y Taekwondo ddydd Iau gan geisio amddiffyn y fedal aur wnaeth hi ei ennill yng Ngemau Llundain. Mae dwy Gymraes arall - Non Stanford a Helen Jenkins - ymysg y ffefrynnau ar gyfer y treiathlon ddydd Sadwrn, a bydd Seren Bundy-Davies yn ceisio helpu'r ras gyfnewid 4x400m i gyrraedd y podiwm hefyd.
translated_content: Hannah Mills has won a gold medal in sailing at the Olympics, meaning Wales has now won three gold medals in Rio. All that was needed was for Mills and her partner Saskia Clark to finish the final race in the 470 class, having already secured gold for all intents and purposes on Tuesday. The race was postponed on Wednesday due to weather conditions, but the two crossed the finish line on Thursday to secure victory. Mills, 28, from Cardiff, and Clark, 36, from Essex, have gone one better than their silver medal at the London Games in 2012. 'I have no words to describe it,' said Mills. 'I can't believe it.' We've sailed incredibly. It's been an amazing event. Jo Aleh and Polly Powrie from New Zealand took the silver medal, and Helene Defrance and Camille Lecointre from France came third to secure the bronze medal. Rio is now the most successful Olympics ever for Wales. So far, they have won three gold medals and six silver medals. But there is hope that there will be more to come, with Jade Jones competing in Taekwondo on Thursday as she tries to defend the gold medal she won at the London Games. Two other Welsh women - Non Stanford and Helen Jenkins - are among the favorites for the triathlon on Saturday, and Seren Bundy-Davies will try to help the 4x400m relay team reach the podium as well.

article_content: Swansea's Jazz Carlin har brudt den walisiske rekord på 800 meter ved det britiske mesterskab i Sheffield. Hun vandt konkurrencen på 8:18:58, over seks sekunder hurtigere end hendes personlige bedste tid, som ville have givet hende en sølvmedalje ved OL i London. Hendes tid i fri stil var den hurtigste i verden i år. Carlin, der vandt en sølvmedalje ved Commonwealth Games i Delhi i 2010, håber at forbedre sig til næste års Commonwealth Games i Glasgow. 'Jeg forventede en god konkurrence, fordi jeg har arbejdet hårdt, men at tage seks sekunder af min personlige bedste er utroligt - jeg kunne ikke have håbet på bedre,' sagde Carlin. Med Rebecca Adlington nu pensioneret, ser Carlin en mulighed ved VM. Men Jemma Lowe havde en anden oplevelse i Sheffield. Hun vil være en del af Wales' svømmehold i Glasgow, men på trods af at hun vandt 200 meter butterfly, var hendes tid (2:09:25) ikke hurtig nok til at kvalificere sig til VM i Barcelona. Lowe var kun 0,09 sekunder fra kvalifikationstiden. Hun får en ny chance i 100 meter løbet på fredag. I mændenes løb kvalificerede Ieuan Lloyd sig til finalen i 200 meter fri, hvor han blev nummer tre med tiden 1:48:37.

article_content: Mae pobl yn poeni gormod am enwau, boed hwy'n enwau ar blant neu enwau ar bleidiau. Yn wleidyddiaeth, fel yn y rhan fwyaf o bethau, mae'r 'brand' yn bwysig. Weithiau, gall ychwanegu'r gair 'new' at ddechrau enw wneud gwaith ryfeddol, boed hwnnw'n enw ar blaid neu ar bowdwr golchi! Ar y llaw arall, gall newid enw fod fel rhoi lipstic ar fochyn os nad oes newid i'r sylwedd hefyd. Ni fuasai'r Ceidwadwyr wedi gwneud yn well yn y 1940au pe bai Harold Macmillan wedi cael ei ffordd ac wedi newid eu henw i'r 'Blaid Ddemocrataidd Newydd'. Hefyd, ni fuasai dewis yr enw 'Democratiaid' yn hytrach na 'Democratiaid Rhyddfrydol' wedi gwneud unrhyw wahaniaeth i ffawd y blaid ganol ond, gwel, fe achosodd y ddadl honno lawer o ffrae yn ôl yn 1988! O leiaf, cafodd datrysiad pendant yn y ddau achos uchod. Mae unrhyw fath o benderfyniad ac o gysondeb yn well na'r anhrefn o eiriau sy'nghylch enw 'Plaid Cymru', 'Plaid Cymru - Y Blaid Gymreig', a 'Y Blaid Gymreig'. Nawr, dydw i ddim yn deall pam mae rhai o fewn Plaid Cymru yn teimlo'r angen am enw Saesneg. Nid yw diffyg enw o'r fath wedi bod yn broblem i Fianna Fáil a Fine Gael hyd y gwelaf i. Efallai bod strategwyr y blaid yn credu bod rhyw bleidleiswyr yn rhywle nad ydynt yn fodlon pleidleisio i 'Gymry' eithafol 'Plaid Cymru' ond y byddent yn ystyried 'Y Blaid Gymreig' fel y peth mwyaf cwl a welodd dyn erioed. Iawn, fein. Os felly, boed felly ond byddwch yn gyson ynghylch y peth er mwyn tad. Dyma i chi 'pick and mix' o ddatganiadau newyddion Saesneg diweddar y blaid. 'Aelod Plaid Cymru yn siarad mewn rali yng Nghaerdydd', 'Gweinidog Addysg yr Wrthblaid o Blaid Cymru, Simon Thomas, wedi defnyddio gweithdrefnau Cynulliad...', 'Rhaid sicrhau adferiad economaidd Cymru, medd Plaid Cymru', 'Meddai Gweinidog Cludiant yr Wrthblaid o Blaid Cymru, Dafydd Elis-Thomas...'. Ac yn y blaen ac yn y blaen. Nawr, fel newyddiadurwr, rwy'n fodlon defnyddio pa bynnag enw y mae'r blaid yn dewis i'w hun ond fe fyddai'n ddefnyddiol gwybod beth yw'r enw hwnnw!
translated_content: People worry too much about names, whether they're names of children or political parties. In politics, like many things, the 'brand' is crucial. Sometimes, adding the word 'new' to the beginning of a name can work wonders, whether it's a party name or a washing powder! On the other hand, changing a name can be like putting lipstick on a pig if there's no change in substance either. The Conservatives wouldn't have done better in the 1940s if Harold Macmillan had gotten his way and changed their name to the 'New Democratic Party'. Also, choosing the name 'Democrats' instead of 'Liberal Democrats' might not have made a difference to the fate of the center party, but it did cause a lot of controversy back in 1988! At least there was a clear solution in both cases above. Any kind of decision and consistency is better than the mess of words surrounding the name 'Plaid Cymru', 'Plaid Cymru - The Party of Wales', and 'The Party of Wales'. Now, I don't quite understand why some within Plaid Cymru feel the need for an English name. The lack of such a name hasn't been a problem for Fianna Fáil and Fine Gael as far as I can see. Maybe the party strategists believe there are some voters out there who aren't willing to vote for the 'Welshies' of 'Plaid Cymru' but would consider 'The Party of Wales' as the coolest thing they've ever seen. Den maksimale straf var blevet reduceret fra 136 år til 90 år tidligere i august efter, at nogle af anklagerne var blevet sammenlagt. Straffen er mindre, end anklagemyndigheden havde håbet på - de havde bedt om 60 år - men det er også mere, end forsvaret sagde, han fortjente, som var 25 år. Manning vil få kredit for den tid, han allerede har tilbragt i fængsel, tre år, samt yderligere 112 dage på grund af den 'hård behandling', han fik umiddelbart efter sin anholdelse. article_content: Den ukendte leder i UKIP i den walisiske forsamling, Neil Hamilton, insisterer på, at 'at tvinge det walisiske sprog ned i halsen på børn' ikke vil hjælpe med at sikre et tosproget Wales. Han udtalte sig efter at have besøgt Llangennech for at møde forældre, der er imod planen om at gøre skolen til en walisisksproget skole. I januar stemte et flertal af Carmarthenshires rådmænd for ændringen. En talsperson for rådet sagde, at de lovbestemte procedurer var blevet ført, og at de havde konsulteret bredt, før de tog beslutningen. Hamilton sagde, at han støtter den walisiske regerings mål om at have en million walisisksprogede i 2050, men beslutningen om Llangennech-skolen går imod 'forældrenes ønsker'. 'De intolerante mennesker her er Plaid Cymru-medlemmerne, der tvinger dette på en landsby, der ikke ønsker det,' sagde hr. Hamilton. Som UKIP-leder i Senedd, hævdede han at have været i spidsen for at støtte tiltag for at fremme det walisiske sprog. Han insisterede også på, at han forsvarede forældrenes interesser, som følte, at uddannelsespolitikken blev 'påtvunget' dem af rådmændene, trods en konsultation havde modtaget omtrent lige så mange kommentarer for og imod idéen. 'Hvis vi forsøger at tvinge det walisiske sprog ned i halsen på mennesker, der ellers ville beskytte det, men ikke ønsker det til deres børn, vil vi ikke vinde kampen for folks tanker til at sikre, at Wales bliver et tosproget land inden for mit liv,' sagde han. I svaret til hr. Hamiltons kommentarer sagde Plaid Cymru AM Simon Thomas, at beslutningen havde været demokratisk. 'Jeg synes, det er meget uheldigt, at UKIP forsøger at skabe spændinger mellem walisiske og engelske talere - beslutningen i Llangennech er en for den lokale samfund, skolen, bestyrelsen og i sidste ende, amtet,' sagde han. 'Processen, der har fundet sted over de sidste tre år, har været klar og gennemsigtig for alle, og på en demokratisk måde.' Rådmand Gareth Jones, Carmarthenshires råds uddannelsesmedlem, sagde: 'Beslutningen om forslaget om at ændre den grundlæggende skoleforsyning i Llangennech har fulgt en lang proces, og vi er tilfredse med, at de lovbestemte procedurer er blevet ført, og at vi har konsulteret bredt.' Sioned Elin, formand for Cymdeithas yr Iaiths Carmarthen-afdeling, sagde: 'At ændre Llangennech-skolen til en walisisksproget skole er vigtigt for hele amtet samt Llangennech. Kun walisisksproget undervisning vil sikre, at børn er flydende i både walisiske og engelske og vil give dem job- og sociale muligheder i fremtiden. Det var forudsigeligt, at Neil Hamilton ville gribe lejligheden til at tage en anti-walisisk stilling som denne, hvilket ville berøve endnu en generation af børn muligheden for at leve og arbejde på walisiske. Hvad kan man forvente af en person, der ikke bekymrer sig om at bo i valgkredsen eller landet, de tjener?'
translated_content: The UKIP leader in the Assembly, Neil Hamilton, insists that 'forcing the Welsh language down the throats of children' won't help ensure a bilingual Wales. He made his comments after visiting Llangennech to meet parents who oppose the plan to turn the school into a Welsh-medium school. In January, a majority of Carmarthenshire councillors voted in favour of the change. A council spokesperson said the statutory procedures had been followed and that they had consulted widely before making the decision. Hamilton said he supports the Welsh Government's aim to have a million Welsh speakers by 2050, but the decision on Llangennech School goes against the 'wishes of parents'. 'The intolerant people here are the Plaid Cymru members who are forcing this on a village that doesn't want it,' said Mr Hamilton. As the UKIP leader in the Senedd, he claimed to have been at the forefront of supporting measures to promote the Welsh language. He also insisted that he was defending the interests of parents who felt that education policy was being 'imposed' on them by councillors, despite a consultation receiving roughly the same number of comments for and against the idea. 'If we try to force the Welsh language down the throats of people who would otherwise protect it, but don't want it for their children, we won't win the battle for people's minds to ensure that Wales becomes a bilingual country within my lifetime,' he said. Responding to Mr Hamilton's comments, Plaid Cymru AM Simon Thomas said the decision had been democratic. 'I think it's very unfortunate that UKIP is trying to cause tension between Welsh and English speakers - the decision in Llangennech is one for the local community, the school, the governors, and ultimately, the county council,' he said. 'The process that has taken place over the last three years has been clear and transparent to everyone, and in a democratic way.' Councillor Gareth Jones, Carmarthenshire Council's cabinet member for education, said: 'The decision on the proposal to change the primary school provision in Llangennech has followed a long process, and we are satisfied that the statutory procedures have been followed and that we have consulted widely.' Sioned Elin, chair of Cymdeithas yr Iaith's Carmarthen branch, said: 'Changing Llangennech school to a Welsh-medium school is important for the whole county as well as Llangennech. Only Welsh-language education will ensure that children are fluent in both Welsh and English and will provide them with job and social opportunities in the future. It was predictable that Neil Hamilton would seize the opportunity to make an anti-Welsh stand like this, which would deprive another generation of children of the ability to live and work in Welsh. What can be expected from someone who doesn't bother to live in the constituency or the country they serve?'

article_content: En konservativt assemblemedlem har opfordret sit parti til at overveje sin politik om at overdrage visse indkomstskattebeføjelser uden at afholde en folkeafstemning. Nick Ramsay sagde, det ville være en 'stor fejl' at gå videre uden en afstemning. Hans kommentarer kommer efter et møde mellem flere walisiske konservative parlamentsmedlemmer og kansler George Osborne onsdag, hvor spørgsmålet blev rejst. Kansleren annoncerede planer om at overdrage visse indkomstskattebeføjelser uden en folkeafstemning i sin november-udgiftsrevision. Hr. Ramsay var en af fire, der fik den konservative whip fjernet i 2014 på grund af uenighed om samme spørgsmål, men de er siden blevet genindsat. Han fortalte BBC Wales, at overførslen af indkomstskattebeføjelser ville være et 'fuldstændigt nyt' område for forsamlingen. Han tilføjede, at det ville være en 'stor fejl' at gøre det uden en folkeafstemning. 'Ét er klart, overdragelse af skattebeføjelser vil ske, men på et sådant vigtigt forfatningsmæssigt spørgsmål som indkomstskat, har vi brug for at gå videre uden at afholde en folkeafstemning?' sagde hr. Ramsay. 'Jeg forstår, hvorfor parlamentsmedlemmer har udtrykt deres bekymringer, og jeg mener, vi skal overveje dette, og jeg er glad for, at der vil være en diskussion om sagen.' Lederen af de konservative i Wales, Andrew RT Davies, ønsker at bruge de nye indkomstskattebeføjelser til at sænke den øverste satz med 5p og den grundlæggende satz med 1p. En konservativ talsperson sagde: 'Gruppen støtter statssekretærens og kanslerens synspunkt, og vi vil ikke undskylde for at ønske at gøre Wales til den lavest beskattede del af Storbritannien.'
translated_content: A Conservative Assembly member has called for his party to reconsider its policy of devolving some income tax powers without holding a referendum. Nick Ramsay said it would be a 'big mistake' to proceed without a vote. His comments come after a meeting between several Welsh Conservative MPs and Chancellor George Osborne on Wednesday, where the issue was raised. The Chancellor announced plans to devolve some income tax powers without a referendum in his November spending review. Mr. Ramsay was one of four who had the Conservative whip removed in 2014 due to disagreements on the same issue, but they have since been reinstated. He told BBC Wales that transferring income tax powers would be a 'completely new' area for the Assembly. He added that it would be a 'big mistake' to do so without a referendum. 'One thing is clear, devolving tax powers is going to happen, but on a constitutional matter as important as income tax, do we need to proceed without holding a referendum?' said Mr. Ramsay. 'I understand why MPs have expressed their concerns, and I believe we need to reconsider this, and I'm glad there will be a discussion on the matter.' The leader of the Conservatives in Wales, Andrew RT Davies, wants to use the new income tax powers to cut the top rate by 5p and the basic rate by 1p. A Conservative spokesperson said: 'The group supports the Secretary of State for Wales and the Chancellor's viewpoint, and we won't apologize for wanting to make Wales the lowest-taxed part of the UK.'

article_content: Den verdensførste smalsporsdamptog, The Princess, blev trukket ud af en pub og gjort klar til en tur til London lørdag. Toget blev bygget i Østlondon i 1863, før det blev overført til Ffestiniog-jernbanen i Porthmadog samme år. The Princess var det første damplok, der kørte på Ffestiniog-jernbanen, og det sidste, der brugte skinnerne, før jernbanen lukkede i 1946. Næste år vil toget rejse til Paddington station i London, hvor det vil blive udstillet i seks uger fra St. Davids dag for at fejre sin 150-års fødselsdag. Men før det skulle The Princess trækkes ud af Spooner-puben på Porthmadog havnestation lørdag morgen. 'The Princess har været i pubben i 31 år,' sagde Andrew Thomas fra Ffestiniog-jernbanen. 'Vi måtte afkoble store døre fra siden af pubben for at sikre, at toget kunne komme igennem døren. En gammel dampmaskine trukket af heste fra Wylfa-kraftværket overtog The Princess' plads midlertidigt.' The Princess blev derefter transporteret over Porthmadog Cob til en nærliggende værksted, hvor det blev malet samme farve som den anden smalsporsdamptog i verden, The Prince, som også er hjemmehørende i Porthmadog.
translated_content: The world's first narrow-gauge steam train, The Princess, was pulled out of a pub and prepared for a journey to London on Saturday. The train was built in East London in 1863 before being transferred to the Ffestiniog Railway in Porthmadog that same year. The Princess was the first steam train to travel on the Ffestiniog Railway and the last to use the tracks before the railway closed in 1946. Next year, the train will travel to Paddington station in London where it will be displayed for six weeks from St David's Day to celebrate its 150th birthday. However, before that, The Princess had to be pulled out of the Spooner pub at Porthmadog Harbour station on Saturday morning. 'The Princess has been in the pub for 31 years,' said Andrew Thomas from the Ffestiniog Railway. 'We had to disconnect large doors from the side of the pub to ensure the train could fit through the doorway. An old steam engine pulled by horses from the Wylfa power station took The Princess' place temporarily.' The Princess was then transported across Porthmadog Cob to a nearby workshop where it was painted the same color as the second narrow-gauge steam train in the world, The Prince, which is also based in Porthmadog.

article_content: Da Kommunionen til minde om en af verdenskrigens blodigste slag, Passchendaele-slaget, har formanden for mindesprojektet udtrykt overraskelse over den store interesse for begivenheden. I 2012 blev historikeren professor Sir Deian Hopkin udnævnt til at rådgive regeringen om, hvordan man skulle mindes verdenskrigen gennem projektet Cymru'n Cofio. I weekenden og på mandag vil der være ceremonier og koncerter i Flandern, Belgien for at markere starten på Passchendaele-slaget, også kendt som tredje slag ved Ypres, den 31. juli 1917. Det var under dette slag, at digteren Hedd Wyn, der posthumt vandt stolen ved den nationale eisteddfod, mistede livet. I en tale til Cymru Fyw sagde professor Hopkin, at 'der har været langt mere interesse end forventet', især blandt unge mennesker over hele landet. Han tilføjede, at projektet har skabt en bred vifte af digitale materialer, der vil blive husket og bevaret for fremtidige generationer.

article_content: Wrexham Football Club har meddelt, at manager Gary Mills har forladt klubben. Mills, 54, overtog efter Kevin Wilkin på Racecourse Ground i april 2015. Dette betyder, at fire af Wales' største klubber har fyret deres trænere inden for de seneste 15 dage, efter at Francesco Guidolin forlod Swansea, Paul Trollope forlod Cardiff og Warren Feeney forlod Newport. To medlemmer af trænerstaben, Joey Jones og Andy Davies, samt den tidligere anfører Dean Keates, vil lede holdet i deres FA Cup-kamp mod Stamford lørdag.

article_content: En tidligere skolesekretær og bestyrelsesmedlem i Nord-Wales er blevet frikendt for at stjæle madpenge. Eirian Jarratt, 60, fra Trefnant, nær Denbigh, var blevet anklaget for svindel og havde taget 10.600 pund. Sagen mod hende blev droppet på grund af manglende beviser. Fru Jarratt havde fastholdt sin uskyld og hendes juridiske hold argumenterede for, at beviserne var upålidelige. Anklagemyndigheden præsenterede ikke noget bevis imod hende på torsdag. 'Jeg burde ikke være blevet anklaget fra starten, når man ser på beviserne, de havde,' sagde fru Jarratt. 'De satte vognen foran hesten. De burde have haft solide beviser, før de anklagede mig.' Sagen har haft en ødelæggende virkning på hende og hendes familie: 'Jeg mistede mit job som skolesekretær. Jeg måtte gå på tidlig pension,' sagde hun. 'Virksomheden, denne sag har haft på min familie, har været forfærdelig. Vi er alle på medicin, og det har revet os itu mentalt.'

Mrs Jarratt had maintained her innocence and her legal team argued that the evidence was unreliable. The prosecution did not present any evidence against her on Thursday. 'I should not have been charged in the first place, considering the evidence they had,' said Mrs Jarratt. 'They put the cart before the horse. They should have had solid evidence before charging me.' The case has had a devastating impact on her and her family: 'I lost my job as a school secretary. I had to take early retirement,' she said. 'The effect this has had on my family has been terrible. We are all on medication and this has torn us apart mentally.'
